notes: Triage 2026-11-22. Queue at start: 46 open stories from 3776 leads in 72 hours, all 46 leak-site claims only (ransomware.live, single publisher); no non-claim stories. Closed 15 claim stories by the small-organisation rule (see skipped). Left 31 claim stories open because they name health providers, education, government bodies (e.g. Clarkesville Police Department, Mid-Cumberland Human Resource Agency), listed or large companies (e.g. Boeing, Eni, AutoZone, Lucid, Aixia Group, Ginkgo Bioworks, TrueBlue, KOWA, William Cook, CDM Smith, Gensler), or the DROP 1 clinics claims in Colombia (Whitearmor). None has three or more publishers or a government source reporting it, so none is a priority-1 open lead; the sweep's claims desk handles them. No non-claim strong stories were open, so there is no oldest open strong story to report. Stories were decided from titles and sources only; no pages were opened. last_triage_at and triage_note are for the script to write, not this worker.
